title: Anthropic cuts benign biology blocks by about 85% while retaining dual-use limits
friendlyTitle: Claude should block fewer normal biology questions
summary: Anthropic updated Claude Fable 5’s biology classifier and reports about 85% fewer biology-related fallbacks in its tests. Everyday health, education and clinical questions should reach the more capable model more often, while sensitive virology, toxicology and molecular-design work still falls back to Opus 5.
friendlySummary: Anthropic improved its safety filter so Fable 5 can answer more everyday health and biology questions. High-risk topics such as virology and toxicology remain limited.
whyItMatters: Safety controls become more useful when they distinguish ordinary questions from genuinely risky work instead of blocking an entire field. Users should see better biology assistance, although medical answers still require professional judgment and research access remains restricted.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People may get better help without removing important safety rules. A doctor or qualified expert should still check medical advice.
